confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from three web searches. These returned aggregator and cost-of-living sites (Numbeo-derived figures, Oysterlist, GoTripZi, MyLifeElsewhere, Traveltables) that mostly report EUR prices, and some are dated (Traveltables was last updated July 2023). I converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.16 USD per EUR. Beer (about EUR 5-6 per 0.5 L), cappuccino (about EUR 3.5-4) and inexpensive meal (about EUR 10-15) are reasonably consistent across sources. Mid-range dinner for two (about EUR 50-60 in one source) is less certain. Cocktail is based on one blog's figure of about EUR 10 for a lounge cocktail, adjusted upward slightly for Old Town venues. Wine by the glass had no direct source; I set it at roughly the same price as a beer, which is typical for Estonia. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings, and July is peak season in Tallinn, so they carry the most uncertainty. The FX rate is the RBA 18 Nov 2026 observation, the latest found. Search results gave it as 0.6720, and I did not open the page myself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tallinn is priced between Riga/Vilnius and Helsinki. Its Old Town tourist pricing is higher than the Baltic average and below Nordic levels, similar to mid-priced Central European capitals such as Prague or Warsaw.
